abstract: On the double plane parametrizing six regular-quintuple windows of a putative rational Diophantine septuple, three square classes control the isolated entry and all 21 pair roots. We determine the geometric fixed part of the genus-73 fibration obtained by adjoining their square roots. At one certified smooth rational parameter the infinitesimal period map has rank 73. The anti-invariant spaces for the seven double covers have ranks 12, 12, 12, 6, 18, 6 and 6, and the elliptic quotient contributes the final dimension. In particular the two characters left open by earlier finite-field recurrence tests have zero fixed part in characteristic zero. The full geometric generic Jacobian has no positive-dimensional constant abelian factor, and the smooth projective surface has irregularity zero. The computation derives branch velocities from a squarefree projected divisor of degree 51 and checks the seven exact rational matrices against a second calculation using local differentiation. Factoring the exceptional resultants determines all rational parameter values at which this projection can degenerate. Torsion enumeration settles the exceptional smooth elliptic parameters on the ordinary chart. Each rational parameter admitting an ordinary shape has only finitely many rational points lifting to the full cover. Existence of a rational septuple remains open.
